events.outcome: Current KPN first-party pages price the prepaid SIM at €4.99. KPN Basis 2021 lists €0.15 per SMS. Credit has unlimited validity only if the line performs a qualifying action at least once every 6 months; incoming calls/SMS do not count. After 6 months of inactivity credit is frozen for 90 days, and a top-up during that rescue window can restore it; otherwise the number and credit are lost.
KPN moderator guidance in 2026 confirms KPN Prepaid does not support eSIM. Prepaid requires a physical SIM; subscription eSIM behavior must not be carried into this route.
Current provider-moderated guidance says a new KPN Prepaid SIM can only be activated in the Netherlands while connected to the KPN network. Abroad-first activation is not supported.

KPN officially supports prepaid abroad and states incoming SMS abroad is free, including outside the EU at destination-specific outgoing rates. A 2026 provider-community case reports a previously used prepaid line losing network abroad. Preserve this as an unquantified continuity risk rather than treating roaming/SMS reachability as guaranteed.

data.acquisitionSummary: KPN currently sells the prepaid physical SIM for €4.99. First registration in the KPN Prepaid app advertises €7.50 bonus credit; do not treat bonus credit as a cash discount. KPN Prepaid does not currently support eSIM.

keep.action: Perform a qualifying action before each 6-month deadline. Under KPN Basis 2021, a standard SMS in the Netherlands/EU costs €0.15, so two such SMS actions cover roughly a year. Calling, mobile data or topping up also count; receiving calls/SMS does not. Outside-EU outgoing SMS uses destination-specific roaming tariffs, so €0.30/year is a lowest documented NL/EU action path, not a universal abroad cost.

data.chinaActivation: Not supported as a China-first route. A new KPN Prepaid physical SIM must first be activated in the Netherlands while connected to the KPN network.
data.kyc: No universal prepaid identity-document requirement established in the reviewed KPN sources.
data.payment: Online top-up is available while abroad; payment-method acceptance by country/card is not generalized here.
data.wifiCalling: Not used as a retention guarantee in this profile; roaming network availability remains destination/device dependent.
data.roamingSms: KPN states an incoming SMS abroad is free. EU use follows domestic tariffs; outside-EU outgoing usage follows special roaming tariffs. A 2026 community incident reports loss of network abroad, so reachability is not treated as guaranteed.
data.tariffSummary: Physical SIM €4.99. Basis 2021: €0.20/min, €0.15/SMS, €0.10/MB in NL; EU follows domestic tariffs. Credit is unlimited-validity only with one qualifying use/top-up every 6 months; after 6 months inactivity a 90-day top-up rescue window applies.
guideSteps: Buy the €4.99 KPN Prepaid physical SIM.
Activate the new SIM in the Netherlands while connected to the KPN network; abroad-first activation is not supported.
Before each 6-month inactivity deadline, make a qualifying outbound use or top-up. Receiving calls or SMS does not reset the clock.
If the line is frozen after 6 months of inactivity, top up within the following 90 days to restore it before the number is lost.
When using the line abroad, treat incoming SMS as officially supported but verify roaming/network reachability before relying on it for critical recovery.
